{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
